# Research Report: Public EV Charging Stations in India

India has a total of 29,151 public electric vehicle (EV) charging stations installed as of December 2025. Among these, 8,805 stations offer fast charging capabilities.

## Total Number of Public EV Charging Stations

As of December 2025, India has installed 29,151 public EV charging stations across the country [1] [2]. This reflects the growing infrastructure to support electric vehicle adoption in India.

## Fast Charging Stations

Out of the total public EV charging stations, 8,805 are equipped with fast charging technology [1] [2]. This subset of stations enables quicker charging times, facilitating more convenient and efficient use of electric vehicles.

## What We Could Not Establish

There are no gaps in the data regarding the total number of public EV charging stations and the number of fast charging stations in India as of December 2025.

# Research Report: India Electric Mobility Index (IEMI) and Regional Rankings

The India Electric Mobility Index (IEMI) is a composite metric developed by NITI Aayog and the World Resources Institute India to evaluate the progress of electric mobility across Indian States and Union Territories. It ranks regions based on their policy framework, infrastructure readiness, and innovation status, with Delhi, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Chandigarh, and Goa emerging as the highest-ranked jurisdictions.

## Overview of the India Electric Mobility Index (IEMI)

The IEMI is designed to provide a comprehensive assessment of electric mobility development across India. It incorporates 16 indicators grouped into three thematic pillars with weighted importance:

- **Transport Electrification Progress (50%)**: Measures the adoption and implementation of electric vehicles and related policies.
- **Charging Infrastructure Readiness (30%)**: Assesses the availability and accessibility of EV charging infrastructure.
- **EV Research and Innovation Status (20%)**: Evaluates the innovation ecosystem supporting electric mobility.

States and Union Territories are scored on a scale from 0 to 100 based on these indicators [1][2][3].

## Classification and Peer Grouping

To ensure fair comparison, the IEMI categorizes all 36 jurisdictions into three peer groups:

- **Large States (17 jurisdictions)**
- **Hilly and North-Eastern States (12 jurisdictions)**
- **Union Territories and City States (7 jurisdictions)**

Based on their scores, jurisdictions are further classified into four performance bands:

- **Top Performers**: Scores of 65 and above
- **Frontrunners**: Scores between 50 and 64
- **Emerging Performers**: Scores between 35 and 49
- **Aspirants**: Scores below 35 [1][2].

## Regional Rankings and Performance

### Top Performers Nationally

Delhi leads the IEMI 2025 rankings with a score of 84, the only jurisdiction to surpass 80 points. It is followed by Maharashtra (78), Karnataka (73), Chandigarh (71), and Goa (65). These five jurisdictions are the only ones classified as Top Performers nationally [1][2][4][5][6][7].

### Large States

Within the Large States category, only Maharashtra and Karnataka achieved Top Performer status. Eight other states, including Tamil Nadu and Madhya Pradesh, were classified as Frontrunners, while the remaining seven were Emerging Performers [1][7].

### Hilly and North-Eastern States

No state in this category reached Frontrunner status. Manipur led with a score of 46, followed by Tripura (36) and Assam (35), all categorized as Emerging Performers. The other nine states in this group were Aspirants [1][2][7].

### Union Territories and City States

Among Union Territories and City States, Delhi, Chandigarh, and Goa were Top Performers. Puducherry was an Emerging Performer, while Lakshadweep, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, and Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu were Aspirants [1][2][7].

## What We Could Not Establish

There are no notable gaps in the available information regarding the definition, methodology, classification, and regional rankings of the India Electric Mobility Index.

## Sources

[2] India Electric Mobility Index 2025 — https://www.drishtiias.com/daily-updates/daily-news-analysis/india-electric-mobility-index-2025
[3] India Electric Mobility Index — https://www.pmfias.com/india-electric-mobility-index/
[4] India Electric Mobility Index 2025 announced by NITI Aayog — https://newsonair.gov.in/delhi-ranks-top-performer-in-electric-mobility-adoption-as-per-iemi-2025/
[5] Delhi retains top spot in India Electric Mobility Index 2025 ... — https://www.bignewsnetwork.com/news/279312439/delhi-retains-top-spot-in-india-electric-mobility-index-2025-with-score-of-84
[6] Delhi leads the India Electric Mobility Index (IEMI) 2025 ... — https://www.instagram.com/p/Dd5etJugbFr/
